Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Cybereye
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 2

Iconic Paired Cybereyes. They install together and count as one item for Cost and Humanity Loss, though not for Critical Injuries or repair. Each eye carries 2 Option Slots for Cybereye Options and arrives with Color Shift, Image Enhance and Low Light/Infrared/UV already in, none of which can come out without wrecking the eyes. Once each Round, when the user lands a random Critical Injury on a target - not a Leg Aimed Shot or anything else that names its injury - they pick which Critical Injury it is rather than rolling for it.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 2 Option Slots, the count for one eye; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each eye.
  • The three pre-installed options are described here rather than installed as separate items.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
